SMART INDIA HACKATHON · VILLAGE SKILL EXCHANGE

Talent exists in villages, but opportunities don't.

Rural LinkedIn connects skilled rural workers with nearby employers — in local languages, with GPS discovery, direct contact and zero middlemen on first contact.

Business model

The PPT proposes a 5% commission only after successful job completion, premium worker profiles, government SaaS and local advertising. The prototype keeps first contact commission-free.

Choose language / भाषा चुनें

The PPT specifies 10+ Indian regional languages at launch.

Prototype demo guide

1. Find Workers → GPS map + verified profiles.

2. Contact → direct chat + SMS fallback.

3. Profile → list skill in local language.

4. Women & SHGs → dedicated local visibility.

5. Govt/NGO → pilot + integration roadmap.

6. Premium → monetisation features from the PPT.
